name: metabase-ui-component-from-figma
title_zh: 把 Figma 设计稿变成 Metabase 设计系
tagline_zh: Linear 里躺着设计稿和 ticket，前端组件却迟迟对不上。这个 skill 帮你查 issue。
tagline_en: Figma specs sit in Linear, but the UI never matches. This skill maps the blast radius, scaffolds or restyles.
desc_en: Update or build a Metabase design-system component (frontend/src/metabase/ui — Chip, Badge, Alert, Switch, etc.) to match a Figma spec described in a Linear issue. Use when a ticket asks to restyle an existing `metabase/ui` component or implement a new one from Figma. Covers: checking out the issue, mapping the component (usage/blast radius for an existing one, or scaffolding a new one), building
why_zh: 它先做影响面分析再动手，避免改一个 Chip 崩掉十个页面；对老组件查引用、新组件给脚手架。
why_en: It does blast-radius analysis before touching code, so restyling a Chip won't break ten screens; for new components it.
limit_zh: 只认 metabase/frontend/src/metabase/ui 下的组件（Chip、Badge、Alert。
limit_en: Only for metabase/ui components (Chip, Badge, Alert, Switch…), requires a Linear issue with Figma link. Ignores other dirs, no tests or release steps.
